exercises.title: RE tools 1 — which kind of tool?
exercises.problemHtml:
Requirements development tools help elicit and document: elicitation tools (note-taking, mind maps, audio pens), prototyping tools (wireframes to clickable simulations) and modeling tools (diagrams with standard notation). Requirements management tools store requirements in a multi-user database with attributes, versions, status and traceability. Classify each tool use.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Công cụ phát triển yêu cầu (khai thác, prototype, mô hình hoá) và công cụ quản lý yêu cầu.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: RE tools 2 — what an RM tool gives you
exercises.problemHtml:
An RM tool can manage versions and changes, store attributes, facilitate impact analysis through tracing, find missing or extraneous requirements from trace gaps, track status, control access, and communicate with stakeholders. Which benefit does each situation use?

Requirements

  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: RE tools 3 — documents vs a database
exercises.problemHtml:
In an RM tool, a specification document is just a report generated by a query and formatted like an SRS. Requirements of different types (business, use case, functional, hardware, constraint) each have their own attributes. Tools integrate with design and test tools so requirements can be traced to design elements and tests.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: RE tools 4 — the real costs of tools
exercises.problemHtml:
Every tool brings costs beyond the licence: annual maintenance fees, upgrades, installation, configuration, administration, vendor support and user training. Tools amplify good practice; they do not create it.

Each question is graded on its own; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
